project_type: Ruby on Rails backend with React/Redux frontend (Mastodon social network fork)
build_system: Rails with Bundler (Ruby), Yarn (JavaScript), Vite for frontend builds
build_command: N/A - this is a documentation/specification task only
test_command: N/A - this is a documentation/specification task only
verification_instructions: Verify markdown documents exist in docs/ folder with correct structure and content
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. This is a spec writing task - no code compilation needed.
contribution_requirements: Spec must avoid conflicts with PR #19059 (official groups implementation). Use occm_ prefix for DB tables, /api/v1/occm_groups/ for API paths, occm_ prefix for OAuth scopes.

key_patterns.models: List model (app/models/list.rb) uses Paginable, belongs_to :account, validates with custom limit. ListAccount uses uniqueness scope validation. Report model uses polymorphic associations, enum for category.
key_patterns.controllers: API controllers at app/controllers/api/v1/ use doorkeeper_authorize! with scope pairs (read/write), before_action :require_user!, set_<resource> pattern. Return JSON via serializers.
key_patterns.serializers: REST serializers at app/serializers/rest/ extend ActiveModel::Serializer with attributes and id.to_s pattern.
key_patterns.services: Services at app/services/ extend BaseService with call method. AddAccountsToListService pattern for membership management.
key_patterns.frontend_features: Features at app/javascript/mastodon/features/ with index.tsx pattern. Lists feature uses Column, ColumnHeader, ScrollableList components. List timeline uses StatusListContainer.
key_patterns.frontend_api: API calls at app/javascript/mastodon/api/ using apiRequestGet/Post/Put/Delete helpers. Types in api_types/.
key_patterns.notifications: Notification model uses PROPERTIES hash with filterable/baseline flags. NotifyService handles creation. Frontend types in api_types/notifications.ts.
key_patterns.oauth_scopes: Defined in config/initializers/doorkeeper.rb with read:/write: prefixes and admin:read:/admin:write: for admin scopes.
key_patterns.routes: API routes in config/routes/api.rb using namespace :v1 with resources declarations.
key_patterns.i18n: Locale files in config/locales/ with pattern locale.LANG.yml. Both en.yml and ko.yml exist. Frontend uses react-intl with defineMessages.
key_patterns.migrations: In db/migrate/ with timestamp prefix. Use ActiveRecord::Migration[8.0]. Patterns include create_table, add_column, add_index with concurrently option.
key_patterns.visibility: Status visibility enum: public(0), unlisted(1), private(2), direct(3), limited(4) in app/models/concerns/status/visibility.rb
key_patterns.streaming: List timeline uses connectListStream from actions/streaming.js. Streams connect via connectStream utility.

directory_structure: Standard Mastodon Rails structure: app/models/, app/controllers/api/v1/, app/services/, app/serializers/rest/, app/workers/, app/javascript/mastodon/features/, app/javascript/mastodon/api/, app/javascript/mastodon/api_types/, config/routes/, config/locales/, db/migrate/
